name: ViTrox Corporation Berhad
overview: 2026年，公司未在公告中披露各业务板块的具体扩张、缩减或新合约信息；已披露的公告主要为季度业绩、股东大会、股息除权及股份分拆相关事项。最新一季（2026-09-30）营收为485,101,000 MYR，同比增165.0%；净利润为118,580,000 MYR，同比增321.5%。
overview_en: In 2026, the company did not disclose specific expansion, reduction, or new contract information for its business segments in its announcements; the announcements disclosed were mainly quarterly results, general meetings, dividend ex-date, and share subdivision matters. For the latest quarter ended 30 September 2026, revenue was MYR 485,101,000, up 165.0% year-on-year; net profit was MYR 118,580,000, up 321.5% year-on-year.
